insight: Attacker-named relay URLs must resolve and connect on one native pinned socket; Send indexing must durably queue the immutable event ID before reporting success; compound Mint must journal the exact signed Coin until public pair, membership, and local inventory all commit.

A development desktop profile can unlock yet prevent New vault creation when its encrypted journal predates the current workspace format. When migration is explicitly out of scope, version the access record, vault catalog, and encrypted journal together. Also create and open a starter file so a successful new root is not presented as an empty read-only failure.

Claude CLI must use stream-json with verbose and partial-message flags for visible deltas; desktop provider HTTP should cross the native host boundary to avoid opaque WKWebView Load failed errors, with renderer idle timeouts reset by text deltas.
